title: SanCtuary is the new #1
body:
[[SanCtuary]] has taken over the #1 spot in the BPL player rankings with 1782 rating points, moving past [[rebebx]].

[[SanCtuary]] is a Singaporean in-game leader, now the top-ranked player in the league (1782 points), with a 1.11 K/D across 47 maps.

title: Lemon Tree swap kkayyteeee for rebebx
body:
[[Lemon Tree]] have reshaped their roster: [[kkayyteeee]] is out, and [[rebebx]] comes in.

[[rebebx]] arrives from Pandora's Rebels. [[rebebx]] is a Singaporean rifler ranked #7 in the league (1688 points), with a 1.19 K/D across 46 maps.

[[kkayyteeee]] leaves as a free agent. They are a Singaporean rifler ranked #362 in the league (969 points), with a 0.90 K/D across 25 maps.

The updated roster: [[luminmochi]], [[Meowcolmz]], [[MoonRaika]], [[JWQI]] and [[rebebx]].

title: Eiromancers sign CodedEcho and twentyrosie
body:
[[Eiromancers]] have signed [[CodedEcho]] from free agency. [[CodedEcho]] is a Singaporean AWPer ranked #196 in the league (1204 points), with a 1.03 K/D across 9 maps.

[[Eiromancers]] have signed [[twentyrosie]] from free agency. [[twentyrosie]] is a Singaporean rifler ranked #28 in the league (1527 points), with a 1.07 K/D across 59 maps.

The updated roster: [[twentyrosie]], [[CodedEcho]], [[Skiazelle]], [[RaviasEir]] and [[kaikaijins]].
